title: Quest/Scene Progression, One-Shot, Delay & Re-entry Triggers
objective: Provide declarative trigger semantics for first-entry, one-time, repeatable, delayed, chapter/phase, quest-state, location-entry, party-presence and re-entry callbacks. Trigger execution must be deterministic, inspectable and idempotent where required.

scope.purpose: Provide declarative quest/scene progression and trigger semantics without creating parallel owner-domain truth.
scope.completion_gate: Trigger execution is deterministic, inspectable and idempotent where required while owner Quest, Scene, Campaign, World, party-presence and time/event domains retain canonical state.

selection_boundaries: CNI-07 is completed_verified before CNI-08 implementation.
Quest, Scene, Campaign, World, party-presence and time/event owners retain canonical state; CNI-08 binds only declared projections, state references, predicate results and execution receipts.
CNI-03 remains scoped narrative-state authority and CNI-04 remains predicate/query authority; canonical callback mutation remains on governed Action/Event and owner-domain paths.
Delayed triggers consume explicit owner time/event sequence evidence; CNI-08 creates no scheduler and performs no wall-clock read.
One-shot and idempotent triggers consume explicit scoped-state or execution-receipt evidence; CNI-08 creates no hidden trigger ledger.
Missing, ambiguous or unsupported trigger evidence fails closed rather than being inferred.
CNI-09+, PCA and SMB-08 remain unauthorized during CNI-08 implementation.
PCA remains eligible but unselected and unauthorized.

implementation_plan.red: Add a focused CNI-08 acceptance and Validation Core profile proving all nine declared trigger families, deterministic inspectable decisions, one-shot/idempotent suppression and fail-closed missing or ambiguous owner evidence before production implementation exists.
implementation_plan.green: Implement the minimum deterministic trigger-plan compiler/evaluator over explicit CNI-03 scoped-state references, CNI-04 predicate results and owner time/event/execution evidence without adding a scheduler, hidden trigger ledger or owner-domain mutation path.
implementation_plan.proof: Add CNI-08 compliance evidence, governance boundary documentation and source-governance verifier; then exact-head Linux/Windows profile validation, client typecheck and deterministic cross-platform comparison.
implementation_plan.closeout: Merge only the exact validated application head, verify validated tree equals merge tree, then OPS3-close CNI-08 and select only the roadmap-permitted successor.
